heroHeadline: Large Civil Rights March Protests Trump Voting Law Changes as Demonstrators Echo Historic Demonstrations
heroSubtitle: The Senate voted 50-46 against advancing the National Defense Authorization Act on July 14 after Democrats objected to passing it while Trump escalates military action against Iran without new congressional authorization. Trump threatened Canada with a 35% tariff (July 10) and announced a 25% Section 301 tariff on Brazil (July 15), while DHS briefly paused ICE vehicle stops after two fatal shootings before Trump reversed the pause within a day. The Supreme Court upheld birthright citizenship against a Trump executive order and struck down limits on party-candidate campaign coordination spending (June 30). June CPI cooled to 3.5% year-over-year as the Fed under new Chair Kevin Warsh held rates steady at its first meeting under his leadership, even as June hiring slowed sharply to just 57,000 jobs.
footerNote: Aggregated intelligence from all US-based Watchboard trackers. Timeline spans Sep 11, 2001 – present.
